standard-dialogue.npc: Hey, [player name]. Got any abyssal pearls you want to trade?

options.text: Let's see what you have.

steps.player: Let's see what you have.

steps.npc: I have my general store, but I also have a small collection of lanterns available, if that interests you?

options.text: Can I see your general items?
Lanterns, you say?

steps.player: Lanterns, you say?

steps.npc: Yes, powerful artefacts of The Abyss. We have accumulated a small collection of them from all of the fighting.

steps.player: Do the wizards not use them in the fight against the abyss?

steps.npc: Absolutely not. We know how powerful they are, yet their magic is too unknown to us to risk using.

steps.player: Could I have one to aid in the fight?

steps.npc: I'm afraid I can't just give you one. We're under strict instructions to only provide lanterns to people who prove themselves as committed to the cause.

steps.player: How committed does one have to be?

steps.npc: If you've fought the abyss enough to amass 1,500 abyssal pearls, that would be enough.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough abyssal pearls in their inventory:

steps.player: Ah, I don't have enough on me right now.

steps.npc: That's alright. Feel free to come back when you have more pearls on you.

steps.text: If the player has at least 1,500 abyssal pearls in their inventory:

steps.npc: As long as you are aware of how powerful they are, and that I can trust you won't lost it.

options.text: I understand how powerful these are, I'd like to buy one.
I'm not sure I'm ready to buy one yet.
What's that rift guardian doing over there?

steps.player: What's that rift guardian doing over there?

steps.npc: They're great, aren't they? I don't know their name, if they even have one, so I just call them Rifty.
That rift they have is a folded-space storage rift, just like the ones Traiborn uses! Small on the outside, but big on the inside!

steps.player: But what's the rift for?

steps.npc: The guardians use it to store things. If you help hold back the Abyss, they'll let you take things from the rift in return.
Anyway, did you want to trade?

options.text: Why are you selling things here?

steps.player: Why are you selling things here?

steps.npc: Sedridor told us to make sure there was plenty of incentive for people to help us. He also wants us to gather abyssal pearls for research purposes. I thought this would be a good way of doing both!

steps.player: So you sell things in exchange for abyssal pearls?

steps.npc: Exactly! I've got some interesting things from the Wizards' Tower, along with some cool stuff the Guardians of the Rift gave us. Want to take a look?

options.text: Could you tell me more about this place.

steps.player: Could you tell me more about this place.

steps.npc: Well, I only really know what the Great Guardian told us. This is the Temple of the Eye, or at least, what's left of it. It was built long ago to house the Eye, a powerful Saradominist artefact.
Apparently, servants of some 'Fallen Empire' desired this artefact. However, in their attempt to steal it, they accidently opened a rift into a deadly area of the Abyss called the Scar.
Were it not for the Justiciar of the Lion, the rift would have endangered all of Gielinor. She used the Eye to close it and then created the Guardians of the Rift to protect this temple.
Of course, the rift is open again now, but with our help, the Guardians of the Rift are keeping it under control.
Anyway, did you want to trade?

options.text: I found this dye in the rewards rift...
options.condition: If the player is holding a dye:

steps.player: I found this dye in the rewards rift...

steps.npc: And you want me to change it to a different one?

options.text: Yes, but how did you know?

steps.player: Well, yes, but how did you know?

steps.npc: You'd be surprised at how often this happens. Lots of adventurers have been pulling bottles of dye out of that rift, only to wish they'd got a different one. I've ended up with plenty of spares.
So on that note, would you like me to swap your dye for you?
